title: Gafgyt_Botnet_Investigation_e9d
description: Investigate and identify the source of unusual traffic patterns and performance degradation in the network.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The network has experienced unusual traffic patterns and performance degradation. Your task is to investigate and identify the source of these issues.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content: You have SSH access to the bot1 host with the following credentials: Username: cyrano, Password: cyrano. Enter 'start' to begin the investigation.
levels.local_content: You have SSH access to the bot1 host with the following credentials: Username: cyrano, Password: cyrano. Enter 'start' to begin the investigation.

levels.title: Investigate Suspicious Services
levels.content: Investigate the system for unauthorized or suspicious services that might be responsible for periodic external communication. Identify the systemd timer name responsible for this activity and report it.
levels.solution: Check running services and system logs for unusual network activity. Look for services related to the Gafgyt botnet.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check running services and system logs for unusual network activity.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for services related to the Gafgyt botnet.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Use the command 'systemctl list-units --type=service' to list all running services.

levels.title: Identify Command-and-Control Server
levels.content: Determine the external host that the compromised system is communicating with. Identify the IP address of the command-and-control server.
levels.solution: Examine network connections and logs to identify the command-and-control server. Look for connections to the C2 server IP address.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Examine network connections and logs to identify the command-and-control server.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for connections to the C2 server IP address.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Use the command 'ss -tulnp' to list all network connections.

levels.title: Identify Persistence Mechanism
levels.content: Identify how the suspicious service is automatically started after a system reboot. Identify the systemd timer name responsible for this persistence mechanism and report it.
levels.solution: Investigate systemd timers and services for persistence mechanisms. Look for services related to the Gafgyt botnet.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Investigate systemd timers and services for persistence mechanisms.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for services related to the Gafgyt botnet.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Use the command 'systemctl list-timers' to list all systemd timers.
